thread:
sre-bot: Pager triggered — gen-queue spike producing 5xx on us-west generation pool. Severity: P1. Link: https://incidents.redwood.example/INC-2026-023
oncall-amber: Oncall Amber here, taking lead. Investigating. Notified eng and ops. Initial customer impact: some streaming completions failing, short-tail queries intermittently erroring.
oncall-amber: Drafting status page blurb, aiming to post initial update within 10m. Draft below — reactions/edits please.
comms-ian: Quick note — prefer "partial degradation" rather than "outage". Add ETA for next update.
eng-raj: Seeing a regression in the batching allocator on the serving nodes; rolling back the recent change now. ETA ~20m for rollback + validation.
ops-katie: Can we list affected regions/models? My checks show US-W and US-E impacted, EU unaffected. Also flag dedicated customers as unaffected.
legal-elaine: Please include "no evidence of data loss" and avoid language that could imply responsibility beyond the rollback.
oncall-amber: Updated draft (please review):
```
We are experiencing a partial degradation of the text-generation API in US regions (us-west, us-east). Some streaming completions may return 5xx or experience increased latency. Engineers are rolling back a recent serving change. We are investigating and will provide updates every 15 minutes. No evidence of data loss.
Affected: hosted generation endpoints and streaming routes.
Workarounds: retry after 30s or switch to non-streaming mode.
```
comms-ian: Tiny edits: change "hang" -> "experience increased latency" (done), add "ETA for next update: 15 minutes" and link to public incident page: https://status.redwood.example/incident/INC-2026-023
oncall-amber: New draft posted with edits. Requesting +1 to publish initial status entry.
ops-katie: +1 from ops, dedicated pools unaffected :thumbsup: 
eng-raj: +1 from eng; rollback started (cmd: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/gen-serving -n us-west`). Will update when rollback completes.
comms-ian: Publishing initial note now, will ping legal after publish.
sre-bot: Status page entry published at 1778889999. Confirmed visible on status site.
oncall-amber: Monitoring. Will post follow-up in 15m or earlier if resolved.
comms-ian: Saving publish copy to ops/incidents/archive for audit.
legal-elaine: Logged for legal review, thanks.
eng-raj: Rollback succeeded at 1778890800; metrics show error rate dropping ~85% in affected regions. Continuing validation.
oncall-amber: Follow-up update (15m):
```
Update: Rollback of serving change completed. Error rate has dropped ~85% in affected regions. We are validating request integrity and completing post-rollback checks. Next update in 15 minutes or sooner if resolved. No evidence of data loss.
```
comms-ian: LGTM, publish when ready.
oncall-amber: Published update #1 at 1778891700. Monitoring and preparing resolved notice.
sre-bot: Resolved notice drafted; awaiting final validation step.
oncall-amber: Resolved: confirmed error rates back to baseline across all regions, closing incident. Resolved notice published at 1778892600. Thanks everyone.
comms-ian: Great job. Postmortem owner: @raj. Assign to eng/serving; timeline due EOD.
ops-katie: Filing RFC for improved canary gating to prevent recurrence.
